title: Agent
description: AI agent identity metadata aligned with ERC-8004 registration format.

schema.description: Schema URI for this node (e.g. https://schemas.agentictrust.io/agent-node/v1.0.0/schema.json); prefer sem:schema when using ontology

class.description: High-level identifier of this node type

agent-uri.description: URI to the ERC-8004 registration file

display-name.description: Display name for the agent (distinct from ENS path)

x402-support.description: Whether x402 payment flow is supported

active.description: Whether the agent is currently active

supported-trust.description: Trust models supported by the agent

agent-wallet.description: Verified payout wallet for agent operations

managed-by.description: ENS name of the company that manages this agent (e.g. company-name.root.eth)

^service([[^]]+])?$.description: service[name] => endpoint, per ERC-8004 eg. service[MCP] => <ENDPOINT_URL>
